experiment_description: Measurement of longitudinal resistance of a large-angle twisted bilayer graphene (LATBG) Hall bar device (twist angle approximately 20 degrees) at zero out-of-plane displacement field (D = 0 V/nm) and zero magnetic field as a function of total charge density at a temperature of 2 K.

charge_inhomogeneity.description: Charge inhomogeneity of individual layers estimated from the resistance curve half-width at half-maximum, measured in cm^-2.

electron_mobility.description: Electron mobility extracted from the zero magnetic field resistance measurements, measured in cm^2/Vs.

experiment_description: Measurement of longitudinal resistivity as a function of magnetic field and total charge density (Landau fan diagram) for the LATBG device at zero displacement field (D = 0 V/nm) and a temperature of 2 K.

quantization_onset_magnetic_field.description: Magnetic field required to resolve the onset of Landau quantization, measured in mT.

experiment_description: Measurement of high-resolution Landau fan diagrams (magnetoresistance versus magnetic field and charge density) for the LATBG device under an applied displacement field (D = 0.6 V/nm and D = -0.75 V/nm) at 2 K.

quantization_onset_magnetic_field.description: Magnetic field required to resolve the onset of Landau quantization under applied displacement field, measured in mT.

charge_inhomogeneity.description: Charge inhomogeneity under applied displacement field estimated from the resolution of the first cyclotron gap, measured in cm^-2.

charge_neutrality_point_gap.description: Energy gap size measured at the charge neutrality points of the individual graphene layers, measured in meV.

experiment_description: Magnetic focusing measurements conducted on the LATBG device under an applied displacement field of D = -0.55 V/nm with an alternating magnetic field and a contact center distance of 2.7 micrometers.

lower_bound_electron_mobility.description: Lower boundary for electron mobility estimated from the magnetic focusing measurements, measured in cm^2/Vs.

experiment_description: Measurement of longitudinal resistance and high-resolution Landau fan diagrams for large-angle twisted trilayer graphene (LATTG) Hall bar devices under applied displacement fields (D = -0.5 V/nm and D = 0.5 V/nm) and fixed charge densities at 2 K.

quantization_onset_magnetic_field.description: Magnetic field required to resolve the onset of Landau quantization in the trilayer device geometry, measured in mT.
